items.source: An extension to ParametrizedQuery exposing query information about its inner structure such as whether constructor expressions (JPQL) are used or the default projection is used.
items.translation: 扩展 ParametrizedQuery，以暴露有关其内部结构的查询信息，例如是否使用了构造函数表达式（JPQL）或默认投影。

items.source: Query implementation to execute queries against JPA.
items.translation: 用于针对 JPA 执行查询的查询实现。

items.source:
Creates a new IntrospectedQuery representing a count query, i.e. a query returning the number of rows to
be expected from the original query, either derived from the query wrapped by this instance or from the information
passed as arguments.
items.translation: 创建一个表示计数查询的新 IntrospectedQuery，即返回原始查询预期行数的查询。该行数可从本实例所包装的查询中推导得出，也可从作为参数传递的信息中获取。

items.source: Uses of ParametrizedQuery in org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query
items.translation: ParametrizedQuery 在 org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.query 包中的用途
